syllabus_topics: Binary, octal, and hexadecimal number systems
Logic circuits: binary logic and logic gates
Circuits with NAND and NOR gates
Basic sequential circuits: latches and flip-flops
Synchronous sequential circuits: Mealy and Moore machines
assessment_rules: For continuous assessment, 5 laboratories account for 50% (minimum grade 9.5) and 2 MAP45 tests account for 50% (minimum average grade 8.0). The final grade for the normal period is based on continuous assessment (50% LAB + 50% MAPs) with a minimum final grade of 9.5. For the resit period, the final grade is 50% LAB + 50% Exam, with a minimum exam grade of 8.0 and a minimum final grade of 9.5. For worker-students and special period, the final grade is 50% LAB (to be completed during the period) + 50% Exam.
bibliography: M. Morris Mano, Michael D. Ciletti, Digital Design: With an Introduction to the Verilog HDL, VHDL, and SystemVerilog, Pearson, 2018 (main)
Guilherme Arroz, José Monteiro, Arlindo Oliveira, Arquitectura de Computadores: dos Sistemas Digitais aos Microprocessadores, ISTPress, 2019 (main)
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LERC Eng. de Telecomunicações e Informática (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia de Telecomunicações e Informática (LERC)
